title: The m6Am methyltransferase PCIF1 promotes osteogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells through stabilization of Wnt-related transcripts
experiments_summary: 1. GWAS/TWAS analyses: Gene-based association tests using the R package 'snpsettest' were performed on 11 published GWAS datasets (BMD, fracture, osteoclast, estrogen traits) to identify SNP associations with PCIF1. TWAS was conducted via webTWAS across 47 GTEx tissues using multiple statistical models. eQTL annotation was performed using biomaRt and GTEx v8. 2. scRNA-seq: Femoral head tissues from 14 total hip arthroplasty patients were enzymatically digested, CD45-/CD43- cells isolated via MACS, and libraries prepared using 10x Genomics Chromium v3. Data were processed with Cell Ranger v6.1.2 and Seurat v4, with doublet removal via DoubletFinder, clustering via Louvain algorithm (top 30 PCs), UMAP visualization, CytoTRACE for differentiation state inference, and Monocle 2 pseudotime trajectory analysis. 3. Mouse knockout models: Whole-body Pcif1-/- mice, MSC-specific (Prrx1-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl), and myeloid-specific (LysM-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl) knockout mice were generated and analyzed at 3 and 6 weeks of age. Micro-CT (8 µm resolution) was used to assess trabecular and cortical bone parameters (BMD, BV/TV, Tb.N, Tb.Th, Tb.Sp, Ct.Th). Histomorphometry was performed on decalcified (H&E, TRAP staining) and undecalcified (Von Kossa, calcein double-labeling) femoral sections analyzed with OsteoMeasure software. 4. In vitro osteogenic differentiation: Murine MSCs were extracted from 6-week-old mice femurs and subjected to osteogenic induction. ALP staining/activity assays were performed at day 7 and ARS staining at day 14. qRT-PCR (2-ΔΔCt method, normalized to Gapdh) assessed osteogenic marker expression (Runx2, Sp7, Col1a1, Alp, Bglap). Western blot assessed protein levels of WNT11, FZD4, FGFR2, β-Catenin, and active β-Catenin. 5. Osteoclast differentiation: BMDMs from LysM-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl mice were cultured with M-CSF and RANKL for 5 days; TRAP staining and osteoclast marker qRT-PCR were performed. 6. Bulk RNA-seq: MSCs from Prrx1-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl and Pcif1fl/fl mice were induced for 7 days; total RNA was extracted, poly-A enriched, sequenced (Illumina PE150), mapped to mm10 via HISAT2, and differentially expressed genes identified using DESeq2 (|FC|≥2, padj≤0.05). GO and KEGG enrichment analyses were performed using clusterProfiler. 7. m6Am database integration: Published m6Am-Exo-Seq data (GSE151229) were mapped to mm10 and visualized using IGV to identify m6Am peaks at TSS regions of Wnt11, Fzd4, and Fgfr2. 8. m6Am site prediction: m6Am modification sites within 500 nt of TSS for Wnt11, Fzd4, and Fgfr2 were predicted using the m6AmPred web tool. 9. MeRIP-qPCR: Total RNA from MSCs was subjected to m6Am enrichment using the EpiQuik CUT&RUN m6Am Enrichment Kit; enriched RNA was reverse transcribed and analyzed by RT-qPCR with site-specific primers flanking predicted m6Am sites; enrichment was calculated relative to IgG control. 10. mRNA stability assay: Pcif1-deficient and wildtype MSCs (after 7-day osteogenic induction) were treated with actinomycin D (10 µg/mL) and RNA harvested at 0, 2, 4, and 6 hours for qRT-PCR to assess decay rates of Wnt11, Fzd4, and Fgfr2 mRNAs. 11. Dual-luciferase reporter assays: 293T cells were transfected with WNT11, FZD4, or FGFR2 reporter plasmids along with PCIF1 siRNA and either wild-type PCIF1 or catalytically-dead PCIF1 mutant (LFPD→AFPA) overexpression plasmids; firefly luciferase activity was measured and normalized to Renilla after 48 hours. 12. rhRSPO2 rescue experiments: In vitro, MSCs from Prrx1-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl and Pcif1fl/fl mice were treated with rhRSPO2 (100 ng/mL) during osteogenic induction, followed by ALP/ARS staining and qRT-PCR. In vivo, Prrx1-Cre;Pcif1fl/fl mice received weekly intraperitoneal injections of rhRSPO2 (4 mg/kg) for 5 weeks starting at 3 weeks of age, followed by micro-CT analysis of bone parameters.
